_note: The M3.5 gate as content rather than as a claim (§17): a pack ships a report that watches its OWN namespaced signal, with no change to src/ and no UI work. The signal is raised by this pack's own ability through core:emit_signal, so nothing in the sim knows the name `kindled:ember:missed` exists. It states a measurement and stops, like every core one.

defs.title: The embers went out
defs.body: {signalTotal:kindled:ember:missed} kindled things burned down to nothing without a word said to them. The last was {last:kindled:ember:missed.name}.
